name: Jump cut
summary: A cut inside one continuous shot that removes time and leaves the jump in view.
how: Remove 0.3 to 2 seconds inside one shot and keep the framing within 10% of the frame width, so that the jump shows.
In a talk to camera, cut on the word and not on the action: one cut every 2 to 4 seconds.

origin.note: Jean-Luc Godard cuts inside continuous shots in À bout de souffle and does not hide the jump.

adoptions.via: MTV starts in 1981; music videos cut on the beat and jump inside one take.
Video bloggers on YouTube cut the pauses out of a talk to the camera.
Gameplay commentary cuts every pause over 1.5 seconds and adds a sound hit.
Video essays cut pauses and hold each clip for 4 to 10 seconds, with the voice over the cut.
Musical.ly clips cut on the beat and loop at 15 seconds.
Vertical short-form apps make the fast jump cut the default rhythm of a clip.
Get-ready-with-me clips cut out each pause between outfit and make-up steps.

sources.title: Richard Neupert, A History of the French New Wave Cinema (University of Wisconsin Press, 2002)
